eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains business, compliance, and responsible-AI commentary, but not two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

claygent-argon-B.reasoning: Trusaic’s own site and case studies establish its enterprise pay-equity and transparency product, named customers, and security claims. LinkedIn and the funding database/profile supply company facts; the dated press center and current job listings support the launch, leadership, and hiring checks. Where no public model provider is named, the provider remains unknown rather than inferred from a cloud subprocessor.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Los Angeles, California as headquarters and the United States as the country.

public_docs.notes: The public Trust Center lists a multi-platform integration guide and an SSO setup guide.

raised_18mo.notes: The company reports no outside funding, so it did not raise in the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

founded_year.notes: Trusaic’s company profile identifies 1999 as its founding year.

last_funding.notes: Dealroom reports no known external funding, and CEO Robert Sheen said the company had not taken outside funding; accordingly there is no round date or amount to report.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 20, 2026, Trusaic announced an enhanced EU Pay Transparency monitor with a real-time interactive map, within the six-month window.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer expose no pricing link and direct visitors toward sales/contact instead.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 122 employees, which falls in the 101–200 band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Sales Development Representative listing for Trusaic was posted online October 31, 2026.

model_provider.notes: Trusaic describes its AI as proprietary and says data will not be shared with public LLMs, but does not name an underlying model or model provider; the Trust Center lists Microsoft Azure as a subprocessor, not as the AI model provider.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations are identified in Trusaic PayParity case studies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board lists one Trusaic opening, Sales Development Representative, and no AI, ML, or data-science role.

compliance_certs.notes: The company homepage labels SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 Certified, and GDPR Compliant.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A recent Trusaic SDR job posting names both systems among its tools.

product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides pay-equity and pay-transparency compliance software that helps global enterprises analyze compensation, identify and address pay gaps, and make compliant pay decisions.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current leadership page does not indicate a C-level or VP start in the window; the March 2026 announcement identifies Aisling Quirke as an adviser, not a C-level or VP executive. No in-window executive departure was found.
